decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's network and connectivity knowledge, fits its move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, and a large expanding telecom provider with strong technical capabilities can keep learning from and refining it.

It extends the firm's established voice and service-management capabilities and supports its strategy of real-time provisioning, though as a narrower portal-type offer it faces a somewhat higher chance of being folded into broader solutions than Product C.
